method: Mix together the sugar, milk powder, atomized glucose, and Stab 2000.
Pour the milk, cream and olive oil into a saucepan and begin heating. At **40°C**, gradually whisk in the dry ingredients until fully dissolved.
Heat the mix to **85°C** and hold for **2 minutes**.
Age the mix in the refrigerator for **4–12 hours** (preferably overnight).
Blend briefly before churning to ensure the olive oil is fully emulsified.
Churn in a gelato machine until the desired consistency is reached.
Transfer to containers and harden in a blast freezer before serving or storing.
title: OLIVE OIL
